title: Scratch-register coordinate
statement: For an exponential breadth-first-search state $S$, the coordinate at index $12$ of its 17-entry counter vector is its copy-and-shift scratch register $Z$; that is, this coordinate equals $S.Z$.
replaced:
For every state $S$ of the exponential breadth-first search procedure, the
scratch-register coordinate of its 17-entry register vector is $S.Z$.
